name: Reference entries display a source URL or link
description: Each entry in the References section should display a URL or hyperlink so readers can verify the source. References without URLs fail this test.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket match cell to open a match detail page
Scroll to the References or Sources section at the bottom of the analysis panel

Verify that at least one reference entry contains a visible URL, hyperlink, or source name that is clickable or shows a web address (starting with http or https). References that only show text descriptions without any URL fail this test.
